items.title: Somalia: Six Million Somalis Face Acute Hunger As Drought and Conflict Worsen
items.description: [RFI] Six million people in Somalia are facing acute hunger, with nearly two million children at emergency levels, as severe drought, conflict and falling humanitarian funding deepen what the UN describes as one of the world's worst malnutrition crises. Medical charity MSF tells RFI it's sounding the alarm "before it's too late".
items.titleIt: Somalia: Six Million Somalis Face Acute Hunger As Drought and Conflict Worsen

items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: Merz spokesman says sees no conflict between Berlin and Rome on migrants
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, AUG 24 - German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's spokesman said Monday he saw no conflict between Berlin and Rome on migrants after Germany became the first of six EU members to start sending migrants back to Italy under the bloc's new Migration and Asylum Pact. "I see no conflict between Germany and Italy," said Stefan Kornelius, spokesman, in response to a question during a government press conference regarding the ongoing exchange between the two countries on the case of the deportations of the so-called 'Dubliners', announced in recent days by Berlin. "There is close cooperation
items.titleIt: Merz spokesman says sees no conflict between Berlin and Rome on migrants
